subject.title: [BUG] drive list/info ignore pagination; info falsely reports File not found past page 1

question: Should `feishu_drive` `info` grow a folder-scoped lookup contract, and should pagination run only when a concrete `folder_token` is supplied?
rationale: The bug is real, but current docs/schema expose `info` as root lookup while the merged list fix intentionally avoids root pagination for bot credentials; automation should not invent the permanent tool contract.

options.title: Add folder-scoped info pagination
options.body: Expose an `info` folder scope, paginate `drive.file.list` only for concrete shared folders, and cover the behavior with focused tests and SDK-boundary proof.

options.title: Keep info root-only
options.body: Document that users should use `list` for folder browsing and leave `info` as the current root-only lookup, accepting that this issue remains a product limitation.

options.title: Defer to a broader Drive lookup design
options.body: Keep this issue open until the Feishu plugin has a broader search or metadata lookup plan that avoids misleading root traversal.

recommendation.title: Add folder-scoped info pagination
recommendation.body: Expose an `info` folder scope, paginate `drive.file.list` only for concrete shared folders, and cover the behavior with focused tests and SDK-boundary proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete landed the current list pagination change and documented the remaining folder-aware info contract question in the live issue discussion.
